notes: REGISTERED on 2026-08-20, on inbound #764, and deliberately not before: the consumer's own adoption PR (BWJ-ecommerce/xoxowildhearts#1) merged 2026-08-19 21:33Z, and this register records what a consumer HAS -- claiming a lens early makes check-connectors report 'registered extension(s) missing' and turns the register into a false alarm. Every field was measured against the consumer's own tree rather than taken from the report: 25 lens files under .claude/specialists/lenses/, matching these rosters exactly (19 + 3 + 3), the plugins enabled in .claude/settings.json against the github marketplace source, visibility private, and the local checkout present. 20 of the 25 lenses are still VUL-IN scaffolds -- present as FILES, which is what the roster check measures, and the intended state for a specialist with no work there yet. THE WORKFLOW SLOT IS REGISTERED as of 2026-08-21, on inbound #800, and the deferral that stood here was right while the answer it predicted was the losing one. It read: their in-flight branch feat-harness-hardening switches the slot to workflow-default, so registering either answer records a state about to change -- write the block once that branch has merged. It merged as PR #7 (merge commit bdf191a); ad315a1 did switch to workflow-default exactly as predicted, and the same day reversed it -- 463e091 'feat: adopt workflow-davekjohn -- the plugin holds the workflow slot', then 01a2723 'fix: disable workflow-default -- exactly one workflow holds the slot'. All four commits were read in the consumer's own history rather than taken from the report. Their .claude/settings.json on main now has workflow-default false and workflow-davekjohn true, and THE STATE HAS STOPPED MOVING is measured wider than main: all 16 remote branches carry workflow-davekjohn true, so nothing in flight moves it back. The empty extension list is the measured answer and not an un-filled one -- workflow-davekjohn ships no agents/ (its folder holds blueprint/, hooks/, scripts/, skills/, templates/ and the portable docs) -- the same answer, and the same wording, as connectors/smartwatchbanden.json. WHAT THE UNREGISTERED SLOT COST, which is why this is a registration and not a formality: check-connectors loops over the plugins THIS manifest lists, so an enabled plugin missing from that array is invisible to the version check. On 2026-08-21 a session-start [ERROR] named three drifted plugins for this consumer where four had drifted, and the one it could not name was workflow-davekjohn -- the plugin that ships connector-sessioncheck itself. Measured across all five connectors that day, this was the ONLY enabled-but-unregistered plugin anywhere, so registering it empties the class. The asymmetry is left standing rather than repaired: the analogous case one level down (a lens present but unregistered) already prints an [INVENTORY] line and the plugin level has none, and a risk whose population is now zero is written down rather than fixed. THE THREE DIFFERENCES THIS MANIFEST RECORDED HAVE ALL CLOSED, and they are corrected here rather than left standing, because a register whose purpose is to show what a consumer HAS cannot carry three claims it no longer has. Each was true when written on 2026-08-20 and each was overtaken by the very branch the slot note named as in-flight -- the same 'a stale line copied forward becomes a false line' shape the workflow's own folder page warns about. (1) 'No CHANGELOG.md at all, a flat update_log.txt with date headers and no ## sections': it has CHANGELOG.md now, 15 '##' sections and the workflow's own intro, and 8541994 'feat: replace update_log.txt with CHANGELOG.md on the plugin's mechanism' is the commit that did it. (2) 'It has not adopted workflow-davekjohn/': the folder is present and fully scaffolded (branch/, prompts/, releases/, README.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md). That also corrects the inbound #763 reading recorded here, which said the standing [ERROR] about a missing workflow-davekjohn/ folder had been answered by disabling the hook's own plugin -- they did the opposite and adopted the folder, which is the other way past that error and the one that keeps the workflow. (3) 'Lint gate pinned at --fail-level crash rather than error, because theme-check reports 1504 pre-existing offences across 171 files (1078 errors, 426 warnings)': ad315a1 moved it to '--fail-level error' and it is green -- five consecutive theme-check runs on 2026-08-21 all conclude success -- so the arithmetic that justified 'crash' no longer describes their gate. WHAT REMAINS TRUE is the reason this manifest was asked for: the register is where the two Shopify consumers diverging can be seen. What it records today is the opposite movement -- they converged, deliberately, and one of their branch names says so (tooling/align-with-smartwatchbanden). A MEASUREMENT NOTE, because it nearly wrote the wrong answer into this file: a first sweep of those 16 branches reported workflow-davekjohn true on NONE of them, main included, while the committed file plainly says true. Git Bash on Windows rewrites an argument that looks like a path, so 'origin/main:.claude/settings.json' reached git with its slash turned into a backslash and its colon into a semicolon, and every zero in that sweep was a fatal error being counted as an answer. MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 is the fix. A count is only as good as the command that produced it, and zero is the shape a broken command returns. CAUGHT UP 2026-08-27 (#978): the workflow plugin's id moved from 'workflow-davekjohn@' to 'contributing-davekjohn@' (source issue #886, commit 8797f7a5) and this record held the retired name. Measured against their live .claude/settings.json (GitHub API): team-alpha@, team-shopify@, team-ecomm@ and contributing-davekjohn@, all four enabled. The sentences above keep the name they were WRITTEN with, deliberately -- they are dated measurements down to the commit, and rewriting one to match today's names is the defect #952 was made of. WORTH READING TOGETHER WITH THE 2026-08-21 PARAGRAPH ABOVE, which measured the enabled-but-unregistered plugin as the only one anywhere and concluded that registering it 'empties the class'. That held for exactly five days: the rename re-opened the same blind spot by a different route -- not an unregistered plugin this time but a registered one under a name that no longer resolves, which check-connectors reports as [INFO] and then skips the block for. The class was never emptied, only its instance was. That is the reason the [INFO] stays an [INFO] rather than becoming an error: the population is not stable, and an error here would re-open the four false alarms of August 9, 2026. CORRECTED 2026-09-06 (#1524): localCheckout is now a LIST of relative candidates rather than one string, because the layout genuinely differs per machine and no single value is true on both. Measured on two machines, both holding both BWJ checkouts: on one the source checkout and a 'bwjecommerce' folder are siblings, giving ../../bwjecommerce/<repo>; on the other the source checkout sits one folder deeper, alongside a 'GitHub' folder that holds 'bwjecommerce', giving ../../GitHub/bwjecommerce/<repo>. The recorded '../../davekokbwj/<repo>' resolves on neither. WHY THIS IS ITS OWN DEFECT AND NOT A TYPO: a path that does not resolve is not reported as wrong, it is reported as '[SKIP] checkout ... not present on this machine' -- a sentence that ASSERTS an absence which was false, exits 0, and suppresses the entire connector block. On the machine #1524 was measured from, that one skip covered four [INFO] lines about retired plugin ids and a drift check reading 26 missing agent-defs, none of which the machine could see. The check now takes the first candidate present here and names all of them when none is, so a register stale about a machine's layout can be told from a checkout that is genuinely absent. NOT MEASURED: whether a third machine carries a third layout. The field is additive, so recording one is appending a string. The 2026-08-20 registration above measured 'the local checkout present' and was right about the checkout; what it recorded was a path that has since stopped resolving, and on this machine never did. CAUGHT UP 2026-09-06 (#1523): the same four renames and the same added fifth plugin as connectors/smartwatchbanden.json -- team-alpha@ -> dkj-team-alpha@, team-shopify@ -> dkj-team-shopify@, team-ecomm@ -> dkj-team-ecomm@, contributing-davekjohn@ -> dkj-policy@, plus dkj-policy-bwj@ (the id that was bwj-codex@ before the rename) registered for the first time. #1523 measured this consumer at 92facf1 (2026-09-01), where main still carried the pre-4.31.0 names and bwj-codex@, and named the gap as 'bwj-codex@ is unregistered' -- but commit aba1905 'tooling: migrate to the 4.31.0 plugin renames' (2026-09-06 18:27Z) landed after that measurement and before this repair, so the live gap is the full rename, not the single registration the issue described. Measured against origin/main after a fresh fetch: .claude/settings.json at 0aafe90 (2026-09-06) enables dkj-team-alpha@, dkj-team-shopify@, dkj-team-ecomm@, dkj-policy@ and dkj-policy-bwj@ -- identical to smartwatchbanden, so the convergence this manifest was asked to show (their branch tooling/align-with-smartwatchbanden) now reaches the plugin ids too. dkj-policy-bwj@ ships no agents/ (skills/, templates/ and the portable docs only), so its extensions array is the measured answer and not an un-filled one -- the same answer as dkj-policy@. The extension inventories were re-counted against .claude/specialists/lenses/ on origin/main and match what is recorded (19 + 3 + 3); nothing else here was re-checked -- not the machine version, and nothing else this record carries. Until this, check-connectors reported an [INFO] for each of the four unresolvable ids and SKIPPED every plugin block for this consumer, so all five of its plugins sat outside the version check -- the same blind spot the 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-27 paragraphs above describe, re-opened a third time by the 4.31.0 rename. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952. CORRECTED 2026-09-10 (#1807): APPENDED '../../davekokbwj/xoxowildhearts' rather than replacing a candidate -- the same regression as connectors/smartwatchbanden.json records for the same issue. #1524 made localCheckout a list precisely so no machine's layout would be evicted, then its repair evicted the 'davekokbwj/' one. Measured 2026-09-10 on Dave's primary machine at source bef8914e: the checkout is at GitHub/davekokbwj/xoxowildhearts (its own project-scoped install record in ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json), so '../../davekokbwj/xoxowildhearts' from the repo root resolves and neither bwjecommerce/ candidate does. Before this, check-connectors reported '[SKIP] checkout ... not present on this machine' -- a false absence that exits 0 and suppresses the whole connector block. localCheckout is first-match and additive: the two bwjecommerce/ candidates stay for the machines they hold on, and this is a pure append. #1807 named only the davekokbwj/ entry for this repo (no speculative fourth path). NOT RE-MEASURED: the machine version and anything else this record carries. This checkout's own origin remote points at BWJ-ecommerce/xoxowildhearts, which is NOT archived (the 2026-09-07 note above), so unlike smartwatchbanden there is no stale-remote question here. This branch appended one candidate and nothing else. MIGRATED 2026-09-11 (#1769), op de vlagdag zelf en na deze consumer, precies zoals decision A (Dave, 2026-09-10) het voorschreef: het register schrijft een hernoemde id pas nadat de consumer zelf is gemigreerd. Gemeten in de consumer in plaats van overgenomen uit een plan: zijn .claude/settings.json op main noemt na de merge uitsluitend <plugin>@dkj-claude-plugins en geen enkele @claude-code-specialists meer. De marketplace heet sinds v5.0.0 dkj-claude-plugins; er is GEEN redirect op een marketplace-naam zoals er wel een op een repo-slug is, dus de her-installatie per machine en per checkout is wat deze migratie afmaakt en die kan dit register niet zien. NIET GEMETEN in deze pass: de extension-inventarissen, de machineversies en de driftcijfers -- allemaal ongewijzigd overgenomen. De zinnen hierboven houden de namen die ze bij het schrijven hadden, per #952. CORRECTED 2026-09-13 (#1902): 'repo' now names BWJ-Development/xoxowildhearts. Measured from this checkout on 2026-09-13 rather than taken from the report -- gh repo view BWJ-Development/xoxowildhearts: created 2026-09-07T12:41:04Z, isArchived false, pushed 2026-09-13T04:56:32Z; gh repo view BWJ-ecommerce/xoxowildhearts: isArchived FALSE, pushed 2026-09-11T07:56:20Z and nothing since. THE DIFFERENCE FROM SMARTWATCHBANDEN'S OWN 2026-09-07 CORRECTION IS THE WHOLE HAZARD HERE: there the old repo was ARCHIVED, so the register pointed at something GitHub itself marked dead. Here it is NOT, and it is a fresh repo rather than a transfer, so both slugs resolve, nothing errors, and a register left pointing at the abandoned one reads healthy for as long as nobody measures it. The 2026-09-07 note above saw exactly this pair and concluded 'that field is currently correct' -- it was, on that day, and this is the day it stopped being. AND #1553's ANSWER TO WHAT THE STALE SLUG COST HAS EXPIRED, which matters more than the field itself: it measured this field as 'read as a LABEL and nowhere else ... all of them display', so that correction landed as bookkeeping rather than as a repair. Two checks have since learned to RESOLVE it. check-connectors.ps1 passes it to Get-RemoteConsumerWorkflow under -RemoteRunners (#1850), which reads that repository's CI workflows over the API, and check 1b (#1821) compares it against a checkout's own origin remote and reports a mismatch. So on this repair a stale slug would have sent the CI read at a repository that stopped moving, and asserted a mismatch against a checkout that is correct. The same 'a stale line copied forward becomes a false line' shape this file already records twice, one field over. THE SEVEN OTHER PLACES IN THE TREE THAT NAME BWJ-ecommerce/xoxowildhearts ARE DELIBERATELY LEFT ALONE, per #952 and per CLAUDE.md's own test -- whether something RESOLVES the name or merely PRINTS it. entry-scaffold-lib.ps1, open-pr.ps1, sync-rules.ps1 and guard-live-theme.tests.ps1 carry it inside dated measurement comments, lens 05-05 inside a dated label measurement, and two archived release notes under dkj-policy/releases/ are historical by the same carve-out language-layers.md already makes. None of them is a lookup. LOCALCHECKOUT IS DELIBERATELY LEFT UNCHANGED, and this is a TRUE absence rather than a stale register: measured 2026-09-13 on this machine (source checkout at Documents/GitHub/dkj-solutions/dkj-claude-plugins), ../../ holds exactly two folders, 'dkj-solutions' and 'bwj-development', and bwj-development/ holds only smartwatchbanden -- so none of the three recorded candidates resolves, '../../bwj-development/xoxowildhearts' does not either, and no install record under ~/.claude names this repo. That is the same verdict connectors/smartwatchbanden.json recorded for this consumer on 2026-09-11. NO FOURTH CANDIDATE WAS GUESSED: #1807 appended only measured paths, and smartwatchbanden's 2026-09-11 note records that even the hyphenated 'bwj-development/' would not have been guessed right -- a wrong candidate does not fail loudly, it goes on reporting '[SKIP] checkout ... not present on this machine' while the register looks repaired. The field is first-match and additive, so whichever machine holds this checkout post-move appends one string. THE EXTENSION INVENTORIES WERE RE-MEASURED against the LIVE repo, because every other field in this manifest was measured against the one it no longer names: 25 files under .claude/specialists/lenses/ on its main, matching the recorded 19 + 3 + 3 exactly, and dkj-policy/ and dkj-policy-bwj/ are both present at its root. Unchanged, and now measured against the right repository. TWO THINGS THIS BRANCH FOUND AND FILED RATHER THAN FIXED, following the one-field discipline #1553 set. (1) #1905: the live repo was seeded at 2026-09-07T12:27Z while the old one kept merging until 2026-09-11T07:55Z, so three merged PRs are stranded on the abandoned repo -- its #208 (dkj-policy/DECISIONS.md), its #209 (the #1769 marketplace rename) and its #211 (the branch-entry gate, absent from the live .github/workflows/). (2) #1906: the MIGRATED 2026-09-11 (#1769) paragraph directly above is corrected by that finding -- it measured '<plugin>@dkj-claude-plugins en geen enkele @claude-code-specialists meer' on the repo that had already stopped being the consumer, while the live repo's .claude/settings.json enables five @claude-code-specialists ids against the source DaveKJohn/claude-code-specialists. The plugins array here is therefore describing a repository this file no longer names; check-connectors compares whole id strings in step 2, so it would report five false [ERROR]s, and it is latent only because no localCheckout resolves. Which way to repair it depends on whether the consumer completes #1905, so it is not decided here. NOT MEASURED in this pass: the machine versions, the drift figures, and anything else this record carries. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952.
